body:
Hi @m4gr3d, [gradle_build/compress_native_libraries](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_editorexportplatformandroid.html#class-editorexportplatformandroid-property-gradle-build-compress-native-libraries) option is now enabled.  The app bundle explorer again reports 16 KB not supported for the new aab I've exported and uploaded. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/38e22377-eaf3-4a16-9987-18404d95548e)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ba1fc39f-f2ba-4bb9-a253-7b8b86bc7dbe)

I believe I followed all instructions in the docs for Android export but maybe I'm missing something. I believe this message is something new. Let me know if you need any details.

@goranovs Thanks for testing. 

Your export configuration is correct; the 16kib warning is new and was introduced recently (see https://android-developers.googleblog.com/2024/12/get-your-apps-ready-for-16-kb-page-size-devices.html) and only became a requirement for future updates a week ago (see https://android-developers.googleblog.com/2025/05/prepare-play-apps-for-devices-with-16kb-page-size.html).

We are working to add proper support for it in Godot 4.5, and will backport the update as a minor patch for previous releases.

The option I had you tried was to validate whether compressing the native libraries was a working option to address the new requirements. It seems like it's not so we'll proceed with the planned update.

Feel free to revert the `compress_native_libraries` option. I'll post an update on this issue once we have the planned update ready for integration in Godot 4.5.
